artifacts.notes: Identifies one late-sixteenth- or early-seventeenth-century pewter lavabo basin at 17.8 by 30.5 by 22.9 cm. It demonstrates one historical morphology and scale only. It is neither identified as a Roman Mass vessel nor used as the teaching plate's exemplar.
